name: dsh-pc-mobile-bridge
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: drive a phone attached to a Windows PC (adb, fastboot, COM ports) from a DSH server that has no USB access to it, through the dsh-mobile-bridge.exe helper.

server.note: Inert documentation only: host packages are intentionally absent from dependencies. This plugin has zero runtime dependencies and uses only Node built-ins plus the global fetch.
